advisories.title: Atualizar o quadro de acompanhamento das tarefas concluídas
advisories.body: O quadro ainda marca as tarefas 02–05 como pendentes, embora as implementações correspondentes estejam presentes neste mesmo conjunto de alterações. Atualize os quatro estados para `completed` para que o artefato de execução continue sendo uma fonte de acompanhamento confiável.
evidence: Premise: .compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access/_tasks.md:7-10 marca as tarefas 02–05 como `pending` → Improvement: o status passa a refletir a execução efetiva e evita reexecução/relato incorreto → Fix: trocar os quatro estados para `completed`.
app/admin/_actions/staff-actions.ts:1-76, lib/documents/issued-documents.ts:1-67 e app/solicitar-bolsa/page.tsx:1-16 → mostram as entregas das tarefas que o quadro ainda chama de pendentes.

advisories.title: Sincronizar o status dos arquivos de tarefa com a entrega
advisories.body: Os arquivos detalhados das tarefas 02–05 ainda declaram `status: pending`, apesar de suas implementações e testes terem sido adicionados. Marque-os como concluídos para manter o rastreamento do workflow consistente.
evidence: Premise: .compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access/task_02.md:2 declara `status: pending` → Improvement: o estado dos artefatos detalhados corresponde ao quadro e à implementação entregue → Fix: mudar o frontmatter das tarefas 02–05 para `completed`.

app/admin/_actions/staff-actions.ts:1-76, lib/documents/issued-documents.ts:1-67, app/seja-um-benfeitor/page.tsx:1-13 e app/form/_actions/form-actions.ts:1-350 → confirmam as quatro áreas implementadas.

advisories.title: Extract the secretariat donor fixture.
advisories.body: The complete donor projection is embedded inline in the render call. A named fixture keeps the test assertion focused on filter behavior and makes later projection-field changes easier to review.
evidence: Premise: __tests__/secretariat-donors-client.test.tsx:11 embeds all donor fields inside render → Improvement: fixture changes and interaction assertions become visually separate → Fix: declare a `const donor` fixture above the test and pass `[donor]` to the component.
__tests__/secretariat-donors-client.test.tsx:10-15 → one-line setup contains both projection data and test behavior.

advisories.title: Extrair o painel expandido da Secretaria em componentes legíveis
advisories.body: O conteúdo expandido de documentos e observações foi concentrado em uma única expressão JSX longa. Separá-lo em componentes pequenos deixa os estados, ações assíncronas e futura alteração de permissões mais fáceis de revisar e testar.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/solicitacoes/client.tsx:108 contém documentos, observações, textarea e ações de download/salvamento numa expressão JSX única → Improvement: reduzir a densidade local torna alterações de fluxo e revisão de dados restritos mais seguras → Fix: extrair painéis de documentos e observações em componentes nomeados com props explícitas.
app/admin/solicitacoes/client.tsx:71-140 → confirma que o hunk recém-adicionado concentra todo o fluxo exclusivo da Secretaria.

advisories.title: Format the donor page JSX into named blocks.
advisories.body: The whole donor page, including the bank-data section and donor form, is encoded as one JSX line. Splitting it into normal multiline JSX (and optionally a small `BankDetails` component) makes copy and account details reviewable and reduces the chance of accidental edits to the transfer instructions.
evidence: Premise: app/seja-um-benfeitor/page.tsx:12 contains the complete page tree on one line → Improvement: account details and hierarchy become independently readable in review and maintenance → Fix: expand the JSX into semantic multiline blocks, optionally extracting the bank-details section.
app/seja-um-benfeitor/page.tsx:12 → the line includes header, all transfer fields, and DonorForm without structural line boundaries.

advisories.title: Make current-document selection explicit.
advisories.body: The comma-expression predicate in `listCurrentIssuedDocuments` mutates `seen` as part of `filter`. An explicit loop or a `Map` communicates the one-current-version-per-kind invariant directly and is easier to safely extend when a third final-document type is introduced.
evidence: Premise: lib/documents/issued-documents.ts:57-58 combines membership testing and Set mutation inside a filter predicate → Improvement: the current-version selection invariant becomes immediately legible → Fix: build a map/array with an explicit loop over the ordered records.
lib/documents/issued-documents.ts:51-59 → query ordering plus the side-effecting predicate implement the current-document selection.

suppressions.candidate: Missing direct assertions for excluded donor fields
suppressions.note: The typed secretariat projection omits sensitive fields and the server-action tests own authorization/projection coverage; this UI hunk has no concrete failure path.
The reordered donor band implements the documented donor-first request and is clear in the resulting markup.
The Drizzle migration is tool-managed SQL and no bounded non-generated polish issue was found.
This is Drizzle-generated schema metadata; no source-level maintainability change belongs in the snapshot.
Drizzle-generated metadata is not a source-level polish target.
The small static capability set is clear and no bounded improvement with a concrete benefit was found.
getCurrentIssuedDocuments checks the application outcome; getIssuedDocumentUrl repeats that check for Secretariat and admits only the current issued-document ID.
The fixed allowlist plus anchored indexed-category regex reject traversal, separators, and non-numeric indices before a ticket is created.

suppressions.candidate: Existing staff rows become unusable during role introduction
suppressions.note: The migration adds a nullable role, backfills every null to admin, then adds the constraint, NOT NULL, and default in an order that preserves pre-existing users.
The unique application/kind/version index is paired with a per-application FOR UPDATE allocation lock in lib/documents/issued-documents.ts.

suppressions.candidate: Final export succeeds without durable issuance
suppressions.note: Decision and contract export tests assert both storage put and issuedDocuments insertion; failure-persistence tests assert that no PDF is returned.

suppressions.candidate: Secretariat workflow has only server-action coverage
suppressions.note: The component test opens operational follow-up, loads issued documents and notes, downloads by issued ID, saves a note, and asserts decision controls are absent.
The issued-document test asserts transaction execute precedes latest-version lookup, while the service contains the FOR UPDATE statement used for allocation.

suppressions.candidate: Client and server accept different required upload categories
suppressions.note: The UI categories, schema arrays, category validator, ticket allowlist, and persistence mapping cover each required fixed and per-student document class.

suppressions.candidate: Secretariat receives the administrator application model through a sibling route
suppressions.note: getApplications uses an explicit operational projection for Secretariat; the page selects a separate Secretariat client and all sensitive detail actions require admin.

suppressions.candidate: Canonical and legacy public routes diverge
suppressions.note: The canonical pages own rendering and dynamic behavior, while both legacy pages are direct permanent redirects to those canonical routes.

suppressions.candidate: Role and immutable-document requirements contradict implementation
suppressions.note: authorization.ts reloads active role per protected operation, admin-actions projects operational fields for Secretariat, and issued-documents.ts persists versioned PDFs under application issued storage.

suppressions.candidate: Canonical public-route and hierarchy contract contradict implementation
suppressions.note: Canonical donor and scholarship pages exist, legacy routes use permanentRedirect, and landing public CTAs use the canonical donor-first order.
The removed upload gate has no executable consumer; schema and server action require category-specific pending upload paths and preserve ticket/storage constraints.
